integrity: Reproducibility relies on explicit Beta-moment products and a stand-alone exact rational algebra checker; finite tests supplement the analytic proof and do not certify it independently.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer m>=3 and large alpha; no finite-alpha exact maximizing-index uniqueness, no uniformity in growing m, no claim for nonradial weights or general analytic symbols. Priority uncertainty remains around inaccessible classical source.
title: Universal second-order Bergman approximation law for conjugate monomials
